promptHints:
Read the current plan, critically review it INCLUDING its contracts, invariants and acceptance mapping (read-only: no replay, no test runs), then write an improved version at most 1.3× the input size and a machine-readable review.

Mark a finding critical/major only if it must be fixed before implementation.

inputs.directive:
## Role reviews

Independent role reviewers checked the plan bound to your `plan` input; the findings file below lists what each role found. Write the next plan version from that plan, fixing every critical and major finding and every unmet checklist item; take minor findings and suggestions where they help. In your review JSON add `"addressed": ["ux-1-1", …]` listing the finding ids you fixed. Report only problems you could not fix as issues.

description: Rewrites the latest plan into a tighter version. Fixes structure, correctness, contracts and invariants in one read-only pass.
